aim.cpp: crosshair delta solver for my own client. Entity head positions arrive as world-space vec3; project them to screen, pick the nearest inside a 240px cone, and return a smoothed per-axis delta with gain, dead zone and a settle radius. delta is delivered through a caller-supplied callback.

(valorant build, operator's own machine.) windows, c++17. write the file, no explanation.
